giving.tag.from.where: The gift tag's small label over the giver's handle, on the gift bag in Giving and in the gift a recipient opens, and before the handle in the Gift Message sent through LINE ("From @alice")

giving.tag.for.where: The gift tag's small label over the recipient's handle, for a gift given to someone chosen in the app ("For @bob"); no screen names a recipient yet, so it isn't shown

giving.giftMessage.altText.where: The Gift Message sent through LINE: its preview in the recipient's chat list and LINE's notification

giving.giftMessage.oneOfOne.where: The Gift Message sent through LINE: the fine print after the sticker's number ("NO.0147 · ONE OF ONE")

giving.giftMessage.body.where: The Gift Message sent through LINE: the line under "From @alice", with the sticker's drawing time
giving.giftMessage.body.ja: {{duration}}でかいた、一点もののシールです。ひらけるのは一度だけです。

giving.giftMessage.open.where: The Gift Message sent through LINE: its button, which opens the gift in the app

giving.give.where: Giving's first screen: the sheet's title ("Give No.0147"); and the give sheet's key once a sticker is picked

giving.close.where: Giving's first screen and the give sheet: the X button's name for assistive tech

giving.backToBoard.where: Giving's "Sealed and sent" screen, and the giver's received notice: the button that closes it

giving.giveSheet.title.where: The give sheet, opened by Give on someone else's sticker board: its title

giving.giveSheet.lead.where: The give sheet on someone else's sticker board: the line under its title
giving.giveSheet.lead.ja: あなたのシールを1枚選んで、LINEのトークで{{name}}に送りましょう。

giving.giveSheet.yourStickers.where: The give sheet on someone else's sticker board: the name of the grid of your stickers, for assistive tech

giving.giveSheet.none.where: The give sheet on someone else's sticker board: in the grid's place when you have no sticker to give
giving.giveSheet.none.ja: 贈れるシールがまだありません。まずはシールボードで1枚かいてみましょう。

giving.giveSheet.noPicker.where: The give sheet on someone else's sticker board: an alert when LINE's friend picker can't open there, such as outside LINE
giving.giveSheet.noPicker.ja: ここではLINEの友だち選択が使えないため、この画面からはギフトを送れません。

giving.giveSheet.pick.where: The give sheet on someone else's sticker board: its key, disabled, until you pick a sticker

giving.meta.where: Giving: the sticker's fine print over the sheet, its number, drawing time, seal day and the giver's handle

giving.sheet.sendInChat.where: Giving's first screen: the bold title of the aqua row that packs the sticker and opens LINE's friend picker

giving.sheet.sendInChatHint.where: Giving's first screen: the small line under "Send in a LINE chat"
giving.sheet.sendInChatHint.ja: 相手とのトークを選んでください。最初にひらいた人が受け取れます。

giving.sheet.leaves.where: Giving's first screen: the note at the bottom, beside a sticker icon
giving.sheet.leaves.ja: シールはボードからはがれて、ギフト袋に入ります。

giving.cantFind.title.where: Giving's first screen: the quiet link under "Send in a LINE chat"; and the title of the screen it opens in the sheet

giving.cantFind.back.where: Giving's "Can't find them?" screen: the back arrow's name for assistive tech

giving.cantFind.lead.where: Giving's "Can't find them?" screen: the line under its title, on who LINE's friend picker leaves out
giving.cantFind.lead.ja: LINEの一覧には、アプリとの共有をオフにしている人と、ここ数分で追加した友だちは表示されません。

giving.cantFind.notFriends.where: Giving's "Can't find them?" screen: the bold title of the row that opens LINE's Add friends screen
giving.cantFind.notFriends.ja: まだLINEの友だちではない？

giving.cantFind.notFriendsHint.where: Giving's "Can't find them?" screen: the small line under "Not friends in LINE yet?"
giving.cantFind.notFriendsHint.ja: まずLINEで友だちに追加して、あいさつしましょう。それから戻って選んでください。

giving.cantFind.addFriendsDidntOpen.where: Giving's "Can't find them?" screen: an alert when tapping "Not friends in LINE yet?" fails to open LINE's Add friends screen
giving.cantFind.addFriendsDidntOpen.ja: LINEの友だち追加画面がひらきませんでした：{{reason}}

giving.inTheBag.title.where: Giving, once the sticker drops into the open gift bag: the sheet's title while LINE's friend picker opens and is up
giving.inTheBag.title.ja: ギフト袋に入れました

giving.inTheBag.lead.where: Giving, with the sticker in the open gift bag: the line under "In the bag"
giving.inTheBag.lead.ja: 送ると袋に封がされます。LINEで相手とのトークを選んでください。最初にひらいた人が受け取れます。

giving.inTheBag.notSent.where: Giving, after LINE's friend picker closed without sending, or a step failed: the sheet's title over the open gift bag

giving.inTheBag.notSentLead.where: Giving's "Not sent yet" screen: the line under its title
giving.inTheBag.notSentLead.ja: 封をしないまま、まだ袋の中にあります。もう一度トークを選ぶか、取り出してください。

giving.inTheBag.send.where: Giving, with the sticker in the open gift bag: the aqua key that opens LINE's friend picker (again)

giving.inTheBag.takeOut.where: Giving, with the sticker in the open gift bag: the quiet link under Send in LINE that lifts it back out, back to the first screen

giving.inTheBag.couldntPack.where: Giving's "Not sent yet" screen: an alert when the app's server couldn't pack the gift, with why
giving.inTheBag.couldntPack.ja: {{no}}をギフト袋に入れられませんでした：{{reason}}

giving.inTheBag.wasntSent.where: Giving's "Not sent yet" screen: an alert when LINE's friend picker failed to send the Gift Message, with why

giving.inTheBag.couldntTakeOut.where: Giving's "Not sent yet" screen: an alert when Take it out failed, with why

giving.inTheBag.couldntRecord.where: Giving's "Not sent yet" screen: an alert when the app's server couldn't record a cancelled or failed send, with why
giving.inTheBag.couldntRecord.ja: アプリのサーバーに記録できませんでした：{{reason}}

giving.sent.title.where: Giving, once the Gift Message went out through LINE: the title under the gift bag as it seals

giving.sent.lead.where: Giving's "Sealed and sent" screen: the line under its title
giving.sent.lead.ja: ギフトメッセージをLINEのトークに送りました。ひらけるのは一度だけです。受け取られたら、誰が受け取ったかがわかります。

giving.sent.couldntRecord.where: Giving's "Sealed and sent" screen: an alert when the Gift Message went out but the app's server couldn't record it, with why
giving.sent.couldntRecord.ja: LINEでは送れましたが、アプリのサーバーに記録できませんでした：{{reason}}

giving.giftBag.pictured.open.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech: in Giving, with the sticker in the open bag
giving.giftBag.pictured.open.ja: 口のあいたギフト袋に入ったシール

giving.giftBag.pictured.sealed.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech, sealed: Giving's "Sealed and sent" screen, and a gift that can't be received yet or here

giving.giftBag.pictured.torn.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech: in the gift a recipient opens, once they've torn it open
giving.giftBag.pictured.torn.ja: 破ってひらいたギフト袋

giving.giftBag.pictured.opened.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech: a gift that can't be received because it was already opened, taken back or returned
giving.giftBag.pictured.opened.ja: 口があいて空になったギフト袋

giving.giftBag.tagged.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech, with its tag's words after the bag's ("…, tagged From @alice")

giving.giftBag.taggedAndStamped.where: The gift bag's picture named for assistive tech, with its tag's words and the rubber stamp on the tag, on a gift that can't be received

giving.giftBag.sealed.where: The gift bag: printed again and again along the aqua tear tape, with the day it was sealed ("SEALED 9.23")

giving.giftBag.pullTab.where: The gift a recipient opens: the pull tab's name for assistive tech, as a slider
giving.giftBag.pullTab.ja: つまみを引いてギフトをひらく

giving.giftBag.pull.where: The gift bag: printed on the pull tab, beside its grip ribs

giving.giftBag.stamps.one-to-one.small.where: The rubber stamp on the tag of a gift opened in a group chat: its small top line, over "1:1 chat"

giving.giftBag.stamps.one-to-one.big.where: The rubber stamp on the tag of a gift opened in a group chat: its big words, under "Opens only in"

giving.giftBag.stamps.opened.big.where: The rubber stamp on the tag of a gift someone already opened

giving.giftBag.stamps.taken-back.big.where: The rubber stamp on the tag of a gift its giver took back before anyone received it

giving.giftBag.stamps.returned.big.where: The rubber stamp on the tag of a gift that went back to its giver, unopened in time

giving.receivedNotice.title.where: The giver's received notice, over the whole phone on their sticker board once someone received their gift: its title
giving.receivedNotice.title.ja: {{name}}があなたのシールを受け取りました♡

giving.receivedNotice.lead.where: The giver's received notice: the line under its title
giving.receivedNotice.lead.ja: いまは{{name}}のシールボードにあります。

giving.receivedNotice.caption.where: The giver's received notice: the caption beside the sticker's silhouette, the receiver and the day they received it

giving.pendingGifts.onTheirWay_one.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: its fine print, with one gift sent and not yet received

giving.pendingGifts.onTheirWay_other.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: its fine print, with gifts sent and not yet received

giving.pendingGifts.andMore.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: the line under "On their way", the newest gift's number and how many more

giving.pendingGifts.to.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: the line under "On its way" naming who one gift given in the app went to; no screen names a recipient yet, so it isn't shown

giving.pendingGifts.label.one.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: its name for assistive tech, with one gift on its way

giving.pendingGifts.label.oneTo.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: its name for assistive tech, with one gift given to someone in the app; no screen names a recipient yet, so it isn't shown
giving.pendingGifts.label.oneTo.ja: お届け中のギフト：{{name}}への{{no}}

giving.pendingGifts.label.several.where: The pending gifts badge on your own sticker board: its name for assistive tech, with several gifts on their way
